player_prompt.intro:
A yi walla Tower of Hanoi bee {num_disks} kubbee.
Ko a yiɓa walla kubbee daga hasum A zuwa hasum C.
Ngam walla kubbee, mooli hasum aranere e hasum yimɓe (e.g., '[A C]').
Ku a yiɓa walla kubbee gorko bee hasum, e kubbee mawɗo ma a yiɓa a tuɓɓa kubbee ɗinɗo.
Ko a watta, a yiɓa walla gote.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A waɗi ko ɓe hara jawdi '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: A wi'i toɓɓere ko wurtata wala.
invalid_move.empty_tower: A ɗaɓɓiti yahugo diski diga towre je walaa kuuje.
invalid_move.same_tower: A yiɗi yahugo diski ha suudu ndu'u.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: A foondi waɗugo diski manngu dow diski pamari.

outcome.win: Koolaaɓe, on timmini dabareji Tower of Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Limgal waylugo yotti. A wurtini {pct}% diskiji ha Tower C nder goonga.
